text: Silo (Season 3, Apple TV+) Super late to the party, but holy shit, this season genuinely blew my socks off. Easily one of the best seasons of television I’ve watched this year. After the lacklustre first two seasons, which I pretty much hate-watched to completion, I wasn’t even sure I wanted to give Season 3 a chance. But I’m so glad I did because this was genuinely phenomenal. I’ve seen people here on Reddit complaining that “nothing happens” in this show, and I couldn’t disagree more. Were we even watching the same thing? Every episode felt like it had some massive reveal, one after another, and the way everything unfolded was so damn satisfying. The writing, the pacing, the mysteries, everything clicked for me. Had an absolute blast from start to finish. Can’t wait for Season 4. Seriously, Silo might just be one of the best shows of 2026. Season 3 was THAT good.
label: analysis

text: I just finished watching Wonder Man, I was a little bit on the fence on starting it since I heard it was a little divisive. I ended up really liking it. Might even be in my top 3 Marvel shows. I'm not too familiar with Wonder Man so the amount it was true to the comics or the lack of big flashy fights didn't really bother me. Yahya Abdul-Mateen II and Ben Kingsley were both amazing. And it's an unpopular opinion but I was a big fan of Ironman 3 so I loved the return of Kingsley as the "fake" Mandarin. I'd watch him in that role for hours. I'm sad it got cancelled, would have really liked to see more of Simon and Trevor's story. Maybe he'll show up in one of the movies but I would be surprised if he wasn't relegated to anything but a very small role. It's a shame.
